scenes.title: Autonomy stays inside an agreement
scenes.intro: Permission to continue does not mean unlimited authority.

items.label: Authorized sequence
items.detail: Continue without routine confirmation at every step.
items.anchor: continue through an authorized sequence

items.label: Scope contract
items.detail: Goal, scope, done condition, deadline, allowed actions.
items.anchor: Define the goal, the approved scope

items.label: Local tracker work
items.detail: Implement and test an authorized local feature.
items.anchor: autonomous work might include implementing

items.label: Separate authority
items.detail: Real messages, purchases, credentials, unrelated systems.
items.anchor: It does not automatically authorize sending real messages

conclusion.text: Continuing autonomously does not expand the scope.

scenes.title: Leave a checkpoint that survives the session
scenes.intro: Each verified slice should make the next start easier.

items.label: Work loop
items.detail: Plan → build → review → fix → verify → record.
items.anchor: A useful loop is plan

items.label: Milestone
items.detail: Persist a checkpoint after meaningful progress.
items.anchor: persist a checkpoint at meaningful milestones

items.label: Current reality
items.detail: Revision, completed work, checks, and active processes.
items.anchor: current revision, completed work, checks

items.label: Recovery context
items.detail: Uncertain effects, usage, rollback, next safe action.
items.anchor: uncertain effects, usage where visible

conclusion.text: A fresh agent should resume without treating the workspace as empty.
conclusion.anchor: without treating the workspace as empty

scenes.title: A blocker becomes a specific owner action
scenes.intro: Record the boundary, then continue authorized independent work.

items.label: Morning Unblock
items.detail: Name the exact blocker.
items.anchor: Write a Morning Unblock item

items.label: Completed work
items.detail: Say what reached the boundary.
items.anchor: what was completed up to the boundary

items.label: Owner action
items.detail: Specify one action the owner must take.
items.anchor: one action the owner must take

items.label: Independent work
items.detail: Keep the blocked feature inactive; proceed elsewhere.
items.anchor: Keep that feature inactive if necessary

items.label: Stop condition
items.detail: Stop when all remaining work crosses a boundary.
items.anchor: If all remaining work requires approval

conclusion.text: Never invent access or label a mock integration live.

scenes.title: Recover the state before retrying
scenes.intro: An interrupted request may already have taken effect.

items.label: Request submitted
items.detail: A provider request was sent before interruption.
items.anchor: interrupted after submitting a request to a provider

items.label: Outcome unknown
items.detail: The provider may have accepted it.
items.anchor: may not know whether the provider accepted it

items.label: Duplicate risk
items.detail: Blind resending can repeat the effect.
items.anchor: Blindly resending can duplicate the effect

items.label: Reconcile
items.detail: Inspect jobs, logs, and durable records.
items.anchor: First inspect the job, logs, and durable records

items.label: Resume safely
items.detail: Preserve valid work; find the first unproven step.
items.anchor: Preserve valid work, identify the first unproven step

conclusion.text: Retry only when the operation is safe to repeat.
conclusion.anchor: retry when the operation is safe to repeat

scenes.title: Keep capacity for the finish
scenes.intro: Dave’s reserve example is configurable, and actual permissions still apply.

items.label: Inspect usage
items.detail: Check before substantial dispatch and after batches.
items.anchor: Check visible shared usage before substantial dispatch

items.label: Reserve policy
items.detail: 25% reserve; 75%-used discretionary cutoff.
items.anchor: Dave's example reserves 25 percent

items.label: At the threshold
items.detail: Use safe deterministic or qualified local routes.
items.anchor: At the threshold, continue safe independent work

items.label: Unknown usage
items.detail: Avoid discretionary cloud dispatch.
items.anchor: If usage is unknown

items.label: Essential work
items.detail: Retain only authorized completion and handoff capacity.
items.anchor: minimum authorized cloud work needed for safe completion

conclusion.text: Platform reality and owner permissions govern the exact behavior.
conclusion.anchor: the actual platform and the owner's permissions

scenes.title: Report proof the owner can inspect
scenes.intro: The morning report names completed work and the remaining uncertainty.

items.label: Outcome + links
items.detail: Lead with the result and artifacts.
items.anchor: At the end, report the outcome and links

items.label: Work + evidence
items.detail: Revision, completed work, pending work, checks.
items.anchor: revision, completed and pending work

items.label: Actual route + uncertainty
items.detail: Usage, assumptions, blockers, effects, rollback.
items.anchor: actual model routes and exposed usage

items.label: Evidence labels
items.detail: Separate offline checks from live observations.
items.anchor: Label offline and live evidence correctly

items.label: First inspection
items.detail: Show the owner what to inspect first.
items.anchor: the first few things the owner should inspect

conclusion.text: Completion is a proven state, not a confident sentence.

scenes.title: Write the overnight contract
scenes.intro: A long run starts with a bounded definition of done.

items.label: Definition of done
items.detail: Local tracker, agreed cases, restartable handoff.
items.anchor: Start with the approved definition of done

items.label: Workspace + reading
items.detail: Name the authorized location, docs, and deadline.
items.anchor: State the authorized workspace

items.label: Routine decisions
items.detail: Make reasonable reversible choices and record them.
items.anchor: Tell the agent to make reasonable reversible decisions

items.label: Owner decisions
items.detail: Identify which decisions require the owner.
items.anchor: Also state which decisions require the owner

conclusion.text: “Do not stop” cannot authorize purchases or unrelated changes.
conclusion.anchor: cannot authorize buying services or altering unrelated systems

scenes.title: Checkpoint before context disappears
scenes.intro: Record enough reality for another session to continue safely.

items.label: Verified slice
items.detail: Revision, changed behavior, tests, and outcomes.
items.anchor: After a verified slice, record the revision

items.label: Current status
items.detail: Next task and exposed usage.
items.anchor: current status, next task, and relevant usage

items.label: External operation
items.detail: Record known or uncertain state without secrets.
items.anchor: If an external operation occurred

items.label: Durable record
items.detail: Use the project’s progress file or another suitable record.
items.anchor: A checkpoint can be a progress file

items.label: Before context loss
items.detail: Do not wait until the end to update it.
items.anchor: It should be updated before context is lost

conclusion.text: Verified commits can supplement the checkpoint when the workflow allows.
conclusion.anchor: Small verified commits can supplement the checkpoint

scenes.title: Keep the blocked integration inactive
scenes.intro: A credential gap need not stop unrelated, authorized progress.

items.label: Local owner view
items.detail: The private view can be built locally.
items.anchor: the private view can be built locally

items.label: Credential boundary
items.detail: The identity provider needs owner-granted access.
items.anchor: the chosen identity provider requires a credential

items.label: Owner action
items.detail: Provide or approve the named access.
items.anchor: Owner action: provide or approve the named access

items.label: Independent route
items.detail: Continue docs, synthetic tests, and interface work.
items.anchor: Continue documentation, synthetic tests

items.label: Exact stopping point
items.detail: Stop when useful in-scope work is exhausted.
items.anchor: When nothing useful remains within scope

conclusion.text: A fake test does not complete the real identity integration.

scenes.title: A timeout is not a clean slate
scenes.intro: Preserve uncertainty until the external effect can be reconciled.

items.label: Timeout
items.detail: The request may still have succeeded.
items.anchor: A timeout does not always mean nothing happened

items.label: Read-only evidence
items.detail: Inspect the provider record or durable operation log.
items.anchor: inspect the provider's record

items.label: Still uncertain
items.detail: Report the state and the exact resolution action.
items.anchor: If the outcome remains uncertain

items.label: Idempotency
items.detail: A supported and used key can make retries safer.
items.anchor: An idempotency key or similar design

conclusion.text: A label alone does not make an operation safe to repeat.

scenes.title: Use the reserve deliberately
scenes.intro: The policy protects the work needed to finish safely.

items.label: Before the batch
items.detail: Inspect exposed account usage.
items.anchor: Before a batch, inspect exposed account usage

items.label: After the batch
items.detail: Record outcomes and current visible usage.
items.anchor: After the batch, record its outcomes

items.label: Dave’s example
items.detail: 25% reserve; stop discretionary dispatch at 75% used.
items.anchor: Dave's default reserves 25 percent

items.label: Reset credits
items.detail: Do not consume them automatically.
items.anchor: Do not consume reset credits automatically

items.label: Unknown usage
items.detail: Keep it unknown and choose conservative routes.
items.anchor: If usage cannot be checked

conclusion.text: Protect integration, review, recovery, and handoff from being stranded.

scenes.title: Make the morning review easy
scenes.intro: Write for the person who was asleep while the work happened.

items.label: Outcome + artifacts
items.detail: Put the result and links first.
items.anchor: Put the outcome and artifact links first

items.label: Honest status
items.detail: Built, verified, unverified, or blocked.
items.anchor: what is built, verified, unverified, or blocked

items.label: Supporting record
items.detail: Checks, evidence, actual route, usage, decisions, recovery.

items.label: Inspect first
items.detail: Make the first few review actions easy to find.
items.anchor: Make the first few things to inspect

items.label: Deadline reached
items.detail: Report partial completion accurately.
items.anchor: If the job ran out of time

conclusion.text: Do not stretch the definition of done to hide unfinished work.
conclusion.anchor: rather than stretching the definition of done

scenes.title: Resume from the actual workspace
scenes.intro: Compare the handoff with reality before choosing the next action.

items.label: Readback versus reality
items.detail: Compare the handoff with the workspace.
items.anchor: compare the handoff with the actual workspace

items.label: Current state
items.detail: Check revision, changes, jobs, and evidence.
items.anchor: Check the revision, working changes

items.label: Stale result

items.anchor: If the handoff says a test passed
